_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 3% of 12h windows producing ±2+ point moves and no breaker visible — funding neutral, VIX elevated but not spiking, ETF flows collapsed — this is a textbook coil where HOLD is the statistically honest call until either accumulation drivers return or a forced-selling flush breaks the range.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst holds with medium conviction citing absent recovery drivers, while the narrative implies a directional bottom-buying setup; the judge sides with the analyst's base-rate discipline
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND stablecoin_growth breaks above 55 with btc_momentum_30d holding 50+
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 75, funding flips negative, or btc_momentum_30d drops below 35 with fear_greed breaking below 20
